column1: # dvb-si coverage — spec allocation lists (hand-transcribed, reviewable).
# This file is the "what do the standards we vendor define?" half of
# docs/COVERAGE.md; tools/gen-dvbsi-coverage.py joins it with the
# "what does the code implement?" half (the declare_* dispatch lists) to
# produce the coverage tables, including the honest "Not implemented" rows.
# Every row was transcribed from the private spec markdown
# (private/specs-md/<file>.md, see the header of each block) and the clause
# numbers checked against that edition's table of contents. Only allocated
# values are listed: reserved / user-private ranges are omitted.
#   namespace  code  name  standard  clause  verified_page
# `clause` is the clause of the edition named in `standard` that defines the
# syntax (empty where the allocating table lives in another document that is
# `verified_page` is the 1-based PDF page of the vendored PDF of that edition
# (private/specs/*.pdf) on which the clause heading and its syntax table were
# read off the RENDERED page (pdftoppm), never from converted markdown text.
# tools/gen-dvbsi-coverage.py FAILS if a row that a dvb-si module implements
# has a clause but no verified_page. Not-implemented rows may leave it empty
# (nothing cites them yet): their clause came from the converted-text TOC and
# is unverified until the code is added.
# ── table_id — ETSI EN 300 468 V1.20.1 Table 2 + Rec. ITU-T H.222.0 (08/2023) Table 2-31
